tools.name: zones_list
tools.title: List Zones
tools.description: List Zones. GET /zones. Use it to browse; the get tool reads one when its id is already known. Requires a token with the Zone Zone Read permission.

tools.name: zones_create
tools.title: Create Zone
tools.description: Create Zone. POST /zones. Use it to add one; the response echoes what Cloudflare created. Requires a token with the Zone Zone Edit or Zone DNS Edit permission. The request body is required.

tools.name: zones_get
tools.title: Zone Details
tools.description: Zone Details. GET /zones/{zone_id}. Use it when the id is already known. Requires any one of a long list of token permissions; see the scope doc.

tools.name: zones_update
tools.title: Edit Zone
tools.description: Edit Zone. PATCH /zones/{zone_id}. Only the fields you pass are sent, so a field you leave out is kept. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission. The request body is required.

tools.name: zones_delete
tools.title: Delete Zone
tools.description: Delete Zone. DELETE /zones/{zone_id}. What it removes is gone; check the id before calling it. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission.

tools.name: activation_check
tools.title: Rerun the Activation Check
tools.description: Rerun the Activation Check. PUT /zones/{zone_id}/activation_check. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission.

tools.name: hold_list
tools.title: Get Zone Hold
tools.description: Get Zone Hold. GET /zones/{zone_id}/hold. Use it to browse. Requires any one of a long list of token permissions; see the scope doc.

tools.name: hold_create
tools.title: Create Zone Hold
tools.description: Create Zone Hold. POST /zones/{zone_id}/hold. Use it to add one; the response echoes what Cloudflare created. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission.

tools.name: hold_patch
tools.title: Update Zone Hold
tools.description: Update Zone Hold. PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/hold. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission. The request body is required.

tools.name: hold_delete
tools.title: Remove Zone Hold
tools.description: Remove Zone Hold. DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/hold. What it removes is gone; check the id before calling it. Requires a token with the Zone Write permission.

tools.name: dns_records_update

tools.description: Update DNS Record. PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}. Only the fields you pass are sent, so a field you leave out is kept. Requires a token with the DNS Write permission. The request body is required.
